items.text: The Eagles will play their first game on Sunday without Jalen Hurts.
items.implication: Tanner McKee starts; first career start context with healthy top pass-catchers but thin RB.
items.opportunity: Pass-catcher volume stable or up with McKee; Saquon also out compounds RB issues.

items.text: Sunday FantasyFootball injuries: OUT Lamar, Saquon/Hurts/Shipley, Rice/Thornton, Love, Breece/AD Mitchell, Montgomery, Mayfield + others; Q AJ Brown/Henderson, Caleb, DJ Moore, Warren, Metcalf/Dowdle, Olave/Kamara, Judkins +; IN McConkey/Johnston, DeVonta Smith, Lamb, Jeanty, Penix, MHJ (Texans).
items.implication: Multiple clearances and outs reshape Week 6 lineups and beneficiaries.
items.opportunity: Parse per-player; IN players regain full roles.

items.text: Eagles ruled out RB Saquon Barkley for Sunday’s game against the Panthers.
items.implication: Tanner McKee starts at QB with thin RB room (Dameon Pierce likely lead); top-4 pass-catchers healthy.
items.opportunity: Increased work for backup RBs and pass-catchers like DeVonta Smith, Goedert, Wicks.

items.text: Ravens ruled out Lamar Jackson for Sunday’s game at Cleveland due to his ankle injury.
items.implication: Tyler Huntley starts again; downgrade to Ravens pass game.
items.opportunity: Huntley game script may still support Zay Flowers as WR2; Mark Andrews less appealing.

items.text: Jets once again have ruled out RB Breece Hall (quad) and WR Adonai Mitchell (finger) for Sunday’s game vs. the Patriots.
items.why: Quadriceps; third straight miss, no practice.
items.opportunity: Allen as lead back vs NE.

items.text: Patriots WR AJ Brown practiced all week on a limited basis (earlier than expected) and is questionable.
items.implication: Possible return; Berry notes sigh of relief potential.
items.opportunity: If active, immediate WR1 upside; monitor GTD.

items.text: Unclear on Qs AJ Brown (ankle), TreVeyon Henderson (ankle), DJ Moore (shoulder). Tyler Warren (groin) Friday addition Q. Bunch of Qs more like probable: Caleb Williams, DK Metcalf, Chris Olave, Rico Dowdle. PIT thin at WR (no Pittman/Wilson/Skowronek) expecting 2-WR Metcalf/Bernard. PHI McKee + healthy top-4 pass-catchers (DeVonta/Goedert/Wicks/Lemon) despite 4th-string RB.
items.implication: Cautious on unclear ankles/shoulder; upgrade confidence on probables; PIT WR concentration; PHI pass game resilient.
items.opportunity: Metcalf heavy usage in 2-WR; PHI WRs/TE safe with McKee.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey has no injury designation for Sunday’s game.
items.why: Cleared; no designation despite prior foot.

items.text: After another full practice, Bears QB Caleb Williams is officially questionable.
items.implication: Levitan views as more probable; good matchup spot.
items.opportunity: If active, Bears pass catchers and Williams himself viable.

items.text: Cardinals ruled out RB Jeremiyah Love (ankle) for Sunday’s game vs the Rams.
items.opportunity: Increased role for other ARI backs.

items.text: Texans RB David Montgomery (groin) will not travel to London and ruled out vs Jaguars.

Loves: Evans (WR4), London (WR6), Kittle (TE3), Kyren (RB5), Javonte (RB8), Rhamondre (RB9), Purdy (QB2), Stafford (QB4), Love (QB5). Hates: Waddle (WR28), Egbuka (WR34), Pitts (TE18), Dobbins (RB27), Nix (QB23), Herbert (QB25). Themes: WSH soft for pass, run volume/leaky Ds, high-scoring QBs; fade tough matchups/QB issues.
items.why: Matchup/usage based; Hurts OUT noted with McKee.
items.implication: Per-player start/sit signals; volume and defense driven.

items.text: Packers RB Josh Jacobs removed from commissioner exempt list Monday; eligible to practice/play Week 7. Investigation remains open.
items.opportunity: Handcuff/backup value drops; Jacobs RB1 again W7+.

items.text: LOVE Mike Evans vs Commanders secondary; Evans is my WR4 for Week 6.
items.why: WSH defense buffet for pass catchers.
